firstPlayerRule: Give the start player marker to whoever can recall the earliest positive memory, or choose a player at random.
clarifications: That player takes the first turn of the Remember phase; turns proceed clockwise.
At the end of rounds one and two, the marker goes to the player left of the last player to take a turn.
